observations.rule: PHP documents that a cookie set by setcookie becomes available in the cookie input on a subsequent page load, not by mutating the current request superglobal.

optionAudit.header-flush: Sending outgoing headers does not recreate incoming input.
optionAudit.request-superglobal: No request superglobal is updated by setcookie.
optionAudit.request-snapshot: Correctly separates incoming and outgoing HTTP state.
optionAudit.httponly-refresh: The security attribute does not change request timing.

observations.rule: FilesystemIterator separates FOLLOW_SYMLINKS from SKIP_DOTS, key/value presentation and RecursiveIteratorIterator traversal order.

optionAudit.filename-keys: Changes keys without creating a visited set.
optionAudit.no-symlink-descent: Removes recursive symlink traversal as required.

observations.rule: Redis documents owner-token comparison and conditional deletion in a Lua script to avoid deleting a lock acquired by another client after expiration.

optionAudit.atomic-owner-delete: Makes ownership testing and conditional deletion one atomic operation.
optionAudit.client-check-delete: Leaves an expiration/reacquisition gap between commands.
optionAudit.ttl-check-delete: Lifetime does not establish owner identity.
optionAudit.transaction-unconditional: Executes deletion before client-side interpretation of the GET result.

observations.rule: Composer documents repositories as root-only: dependency repository declarations are not loaded during resolution of the root project.

optionAudit.root-repository: Makes the approved package source available to the root resolver.
optionAudit.autoload-map: Changes class-path mapping, not package metadata discovery.
optionAudit.development-stability: Changes version filtering without adding a source.

observations.rule: HTTP semantics define 204 as having no content and distinguish it from 200 representation responses and 304 conditional responses.

optionAudit.length-header: Cannot authorize content forbidden by the selected status.
optionAudit.representation-success: Provides a status compatible with the required representation.

observations.rule: PHP documents setcookie’s automatic value encoding and automatic decoding when the cookie is received; the explicit rawurlencode adds a separate layer.

optionAudit.still-percent-encoded: Tracks the two encodings and one incoming decoding.
optionAudit.plus-form: Uses the wrong direction and representation rule.

observations.rule: PSR-7 distinguishes getHeader’s value array from getHeaderLine’s comma joining, warns about Set-Cookie, and PHP header supports nonreplacing emission with false.

optionAudit.comma-line: Still combines cookie fields into one comma-joined value.
optionAudit.replace-each: Uses replacing emission for repeated field names.
optionAudit.append-each: Preserves both value boundaries and repeated lines.

observations.rule: libcurl documents CUSTOMREQUEST as changing the sent method string without changing transfer behavior, and distinguishes it from CURLOPT_HTTPGET.

optionAudit.automatic-get: Invents an automatic reset of body options.
optionAudit.method-only: Separates the custom token from configured behavior.
optionAudit.post-wins: Incorrectly says the explicit custom token is ignored.

observations.rule: PDO documents that emulated prepare does not communicate with the server and therefore does not validate the statement there; ERRMODE_EXCEPTION reports execution errors as exceptions.

optionAudit.execute-boundary: Places the server validation failure at execution and outside the existing catch.
optionAudit.exception-forces-validation: Conflates preparation mechanism with error mode.
optionAudit.fetch-boundary: Defers server query validation beyond execution incorrectly.

observations.expectedError: Return value must be of type array

observations.rule: random_bytes supplies cryptographically secure random bytes; bin2hex represents each byte with two hex digits. The entropy arithmetic is reviewed, not inferred from a statistical sample.

optionAudit.short-bytes: Fails both bit and character counts.
optionAudit.integer-padding: Meets width but has at most 63 random bits.

observations.rule: PHP fsync requests file synchronization. Linux documents that persisting the containing directory entry requires a separate directory fsync. No power-failure simulation is claimed.

optionAudit.rename-after-flush: Omits storage synchronization for content and name.
optionAudit.lock-and-rename: Adds coordination but no durability barrier.
optionAudit.file-sync-only: Leaves the post-rename directory update unsynchronized.
optionAudit.file-then-directory: Orders both required barriers before success.

observations.rule: PHPUnit requires expectException before the code expected to throw. Narrowing the expectation’s active region excludes arrangement errors of the same class.

optionAudit.expect-after-arrange: Separates fixture creation from the expected failure.
optionAudit.expected-message: Cannot distinguish the stipulated identical messages.
optionAudit.catch-arrangement: Retains a catch spanning both candidate sources.

observations.rule: PHP static properties belong to the class rather than an individual object; PHPUnit setup runs for each test and can establish a deterministic fixture.

optionAudit.reset-per-test: Restores the required entry condition before each case.

observations.rule: The explicit READ COMMITTED schedule permits both initial selects to observe 100; later constant assignments overwrite rather than recompute. A shared PDO session is not two concurrent transactions.

optionAudit.serial-transactions: Second calculation uses the updated balance.
optionAudit.shared-connection: Does not establish independent transactional sessions.
optionAudit.barrier-after-reads: Forces both calculations to use the same original value.
optionAudit.barrier-before-read: Delays the second read until it is fresh.

observations.rule: PHP classes can implement multiple interfaces, each declaring a distinct method contract; consumers can type their dependencies to the relevant interface.

optionAudit.reader-writer-contracts: Narrows the reporting API without deleting writer functionality.
optionAudit.public-flag: Leaves all methods in the type contract.
optionAudit.report-subclass: Inherits the unwanted public API unchanged.

observations.rule: The explicit requirement concerns distinct upload records. Only the option using a separately allocated non-overwriting key preserves two repeated submissions.

optionAudit.allocated-key: Preserves separate identities through atomic allocation.
optionAudit.user-and-name: Still collides for one user’s repeated name.

observations.rule: BackedEnum::tryFrom returns null for an unknown backing value, while from throws ValueError. The adapter must explicitly preserve the external value and branch on known versus unknown.

optionAudit.default-queued: Invents a known action for an unknown status.
optionAudit.known-or-unknown: Preserves raw data and separates action dispatch.
optionAudit.direct-from: Stops the stated processing path on an unknown value.

observations.rule: RFC 9111 distinguishes no-store from no-cache, private and freshness directives. The question concerns the new response’s storage policy, not removal of historical copies.

optionAudit.revalidate: Allows storage with validation before reuse.
optionAudit.no-storage: Forbids compliant cache storage of the response.

observations.rule: Composer documents that a library’s lock file does not control consuming projects and recommends testing updated and lower compatible resolutions.

optionAudit.copy-lock-to-consumers: Replaces an unrelated root dependency graph.

observations.rule: PHP documents the combined PHP and libxml version requirement for LIBXML_NO_XXE. LIBXML_NONET addresses network access, not every external entity source.

optionAudit.php-version-only: Accepts a runtime missing the required capability.
optionAudit.capability-check: Checks the actual requirement and rejects the unsupported build.

observations.rule: Under the explicit transactional and uniqueness premises, one commit contains both claim and effect. Separate commits admit the stated crash windows.

optionAudit.marker-first: Can commit suppression without the effect.
optionAudit.effect-first: Can commit the effect without suppression.
optionAudit.one-transaction: Commits or rolls back the two related changes together.
optionAudit.memory-marker: Does not survive the required delivery and worker lifecycle.

observations.rule: Authenticated ciphertext depends on its encryption key. The explicit routine-rotation requirements need retained old-read capability until verified migration or expiry removes every required dependency.

optionAudit.replace-one-key: Loses the key needed by existing ciphertext.
optionAudit.read-old-write-new: Preserves reads and defines an evidence-based retirement condition.
optionAudit.expiry-only: Can retire a key still needed by required data.

observations.rule: PSR-7 streams expose seekability and mutable cursor state, while message withBody returns a new instance. The stated helper enforces the independent size constraint.

optionAudit.bounded-replay: Preserves bytes, position, size policy and message replacement.
optionAudit.ignore-replacement: Discards the message carrying the new body.
